name: create_cash_closings
query: create table if not exists public.cash_closings (id bigint generated by default as identity primary key, closure_date date not null unique, expected_cash numeric(14,2) not null default 0, expected_debit numeric(14,2) not null default 0, expected_credit numeric(14,2) not null default 0, expected_pix numeric(14,2) not null default 0, counted_cash numeric(14,2) not null default 0, counted_debit numeric(14,2) not null default 0, counted_credit numeric(14,2) not null default 0, counted_pix numeric(14,2) not null default 0, difference_cash numeric(14,2) not null default 0, difference_debit numeric(14,2) not null default 0, difference_credit numeric(14,2) not null default 0, difference_pix numeric(14,2) not null default 0, difference_total numeric(14,2) not null default 0, sales_count integer not null default 0, notes text, closed_by bigint, closed_at timestamptz not null default now()); alter table public.cash_closings enable row level security; create or replace function public.get_cash_summary(p_closure_date date) returns jsonb language sql stable set search_path = public as $$ select jsonb_build_object('closureDate', p_closure_date, 'salesCount', count(*)::integer, 'cash', coalesce(sum(case when payment_method = 'dinheiro' then total_amount else 0 end), 0), 'debit', coalesce(sum(case when payment_method = 'debito' then total_amount else 0 end), 0), 'credit', coalesce(sum(case when payment_method = 'credito' then total_amount else 0 end), 0), 'pix', coalesce(sum(case when payment_method = 'pix' then total_amount else 0 end), 0), 'total', coalesce(sum(total_amount), 0)) from public.sales where completed_at >= (p_closure_date::timestamp at time zone 'America/Sao_Paulo') and completed_at < ((p_closure_date + 1)::timestamp at time zone 'America/Sao_Paulo'); $$; create or replace function public.close_cash_day(p_closure_date date, p_counted_cash numeric, p_counted_debit numeric, p_counted_credit numeric, p_counted_pix numeric, p_notes text, p_closed_by bigint) returns jsonb language plpgsql security definer set search_path = public as $$ declare v_summary jsonb; v_id bigint; begin if exists (select 1 from public.cash_closings where closure_date = p_closure_date) then raise exception 'O caixa desta data já foi fechado.' using errcode = '23505'; end if; v_summary := public.get_cash_summary(p_closure_date); insert into public.cash_closings (closure_date, expected_cash, expected_debit, expected_credit, expected_pix, counted_cash, counted_debit, counted_credit, counted_pix, difference_cash, difference_debit, difference_credit, difference_pix, difference_total, sales_count, notes, closed_by) values (p_closure_date, coalesce((v_summary->>'cash')::numeric, 0), coalesce((v_summary->>'debit')::numeric, 0), coalesce((v_summary->>'credit')::numeric, 0), coalesce((v_summary->>'pix')::numeric, 0), p_counted_cash, p_counted_debit, p_counted_credit, p_counted_pix, p_counted_cash - coalesce((v_summary->>'cash')::numeric, 0), p_counted_debit - coalesce((v_summary->>'debit')::numeric, 0), p_counted_credit - coalesce((v_summary->>'credit')::numeric, 0), p_counted_pix - coalesce((v_summary->>'pix')::numeric, 0), (p_counted_cash + p_counted_debit + p_counted_credit + p_counted_pix) - coalesce((v_summary->>'total')::numeric, 0), coalesce((v_summary->>'salesCount')::integer, 0), nullif(trim(p_notes), ''), p_closed_by) returning id into v_id; return v_summary || jsonb_build_object('id', v_id, 'closedAt', now()); end; $$; revoke all on function public.get_cash_summary(date) from public; revoke all on function public.close_cash_day(date, numeric, numeric, numeric, numeric, text, bigint) from public; grant execute on function public.get_cash_summary(date) to service_role; grant execute on function public.close_cash_day(date, numeric, numeric, numeric, numeric, text, bigint) to service_role;
